title: lap_recorded
description: Emitted by the plugin each time a pilot completes a lap

source.description: How the lap was detected: gms from the pilot's GMS player property, event200 from Photon event 200. Both usually report the same crossing, and the plugin drops the second report

is_host.description: Since 1.4.0. Always true when sent: a copy of the plugin in a room its game doesn't host writes this to its own race log with false and doesn't send it
